title: Now, let's work on your educator expenses.
text: Now, let's work on your educator expenses. You can tell us about classroom and professional development expenses you or Casey paid for grades K–12 in 2025 while you were one of these: Teacher Instructor Counselor Principal Aide You can deduct up to $300 of your expenses. Personal protective equipment (PPE), disinfectant and other supplies used to prevent the spread of coronavirus also qualify for this deduction.
